existingEgressContinuations.semanticContinuation: Existing fixed provider operation is unchanged. GitHub publication now propagates original context, rejects security denial and exposes pending approval without deployment or successful commit evidence.

Existing fixed provider operation is unchanged. GitHub publication now propagates original context, rejects security denial and exposes pending approval without deployment or successful commit evidence.

defects: Raw-token GitHub transport could dispatch source and writes without issued actor or exact durable approval.
Rollback force-reset a branch and could then deploy without its own admission.
Template export adopted existing feature branches, treated unavailable trees as empty and lacked exact source/commit receipt binding.
Publication callers could mislabel a pending approval as a completed commit and begin a separate deployment.
correction: One original-context/current-credential scoped fixed GitHub transport, exact managed producer proof and canonical one-use durable claim gate every native mutation. Source is secret-checked and sealed or privately owner-scoped, templates rebuild deterministically with exact hash. Target repo, visibility, head, feature branch, deletes, source bytes and full credential epoch are immutable across approval. Existing atomic writer and compare-and-swap are retained, blob hashes and tree/commit/ref receipts verified, no force or alternate source/ref fallback. Restoration creates a new commit preserving history. Actual HTTP/pipeline/delivery/frontend callers expose pending review and never fabricate a commit or deploy from that state. Analysis cache is credential-epoch partitioned. Static generated request code builds the runtime Authorization header without embedding a credential-shaped literal. Real credential values remain denied by the unchanged floor.
limitations: All provider/database protocols are synthetic local execution, not a live customer GitHub mutation. No repository, Actions run or provider charge was created.
Large arbitrary source requires an owned private project source snapshot. Templates use immutable server allowlisted reconstruction with full source digest.
Existing repository hooks/Actions can execute approved code under user GitHub billing. The exact native review states this effect. No third-party billing success is claimed.
Historical 147-of-148 suite failed only on a template static header example. That exact failure and later corrected positive/negative template execution are retained.
This proof does not certify browser consequential actions, other upstream callers, all12 criteria or production acceptance.
